meta.triageRationale: One story with one obvious approach: read two optional keys from the global config and pass them to the existing update paths.

body.summary: The daemon update follows a configured git remote URL and branch (daemonUpdate.repoUrl and daemonUpdate.branch in ~/.insrc/config.json). A shared validated reader feeds the daemon.update helper (new --repo-url flag on daemon-ctl.sh) and the CLI update; both fetch with an explicit refspec for the single-branch install, check the tree before touching origin, and refuse to discard local-only commits when switching.
